نتغابن (form VI)
# نَتَغَابَنُ (nataḡābanu) /na.ta.ɣaː.ba.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَغَابَنَ (taḡābana)
# نَتَغَابَنَ (nataḡābana) /na.ta.ɣaː.ba.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَغَابَنَ (taḡābana)
# نَتَغَابَنْ (nataḡāban) /na.ta.ɣaː.ban/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَغَابَنَ (taḡābana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
